about_the_game:
Welcome to "Rainbow Cloud: A GAY RPG" , a visually stunning side-scrolling action RPG. The story is set in a medieval fantasy world centered around the main character, Eric, and takes place on the continent of Beruta. On this continent, you can interact with a variety of characters, including humans, demons, angels, giants, orcs, bearfolk, tigerfolk, werewolves, elves, and more.

In this demo, you will experience the first chapter of the game, get familiar with the combat system and gameplay, and learn about the background and development of the story. Legend has it that 1,000 years ago, in the distant Cloud Continent, the human king Azrael signed a pact with demons at the cost of his soul to gain the power to repel the giants and protect humanity from their enslavement and invasion. A thousand years later, Azrael's reincarnation, Eric, still cannot escape the control of the demons, and with his reincarnation, the giants gradually awaken. Under the manipulation of demons and the interference of angels, will he become the destroyer or the savior of this world? You can experience these plotlines in the demo.

The main game features an open world map, while the demo unlocks 20% of the scenes, including underground caves, beaches, castles, and more. The demo lasts for about 2 to 3 hours, primarily to introduce the protagonist's background and the world's lore.

Additionally, the demo includes a dynamic combat system: master various spells and skills to defeat enemies in real-time combat. Execute complex combos, dodge, block, and unleash devastating special attacks to turn the tide of battle.

The first chapter of the game includes a main boss and a hidden boss, as well as many NPCs with whom you can engage in dialogue. The demo also features numerous comic-style CG images to enhance the storytelling experience.

The demo currently supports Chinese, English, French, Japanese, and Spanish.

We value player feedback greatly, and we hope you will share your experiences and suggestions to help us improve the game. Download the "Rainbow Cloud: A GAY RPG" Demo now and begin your adventure!
